$comment: Type schema for data/bench.csv, used by the CSV->JSONL benchmark to bring mq-bridge's output in line with Sling's. mq-bridge's CSV reader emits every field as a string; Sling infers `id` as an integer, leaves the other scalars as strings, and parses the embedded JSON in `attributes` into a nested object. Declaring the types here makes the transform middleware reproduce all of that: `coerce` widens the `id` string to an integer, and `contentMediaType` on `attributes` decodes the embedded document. Both tools therefore do the same per-row work, and it is priced into the benchmark timing.
